name: Meeting Notes
tagline: Email it your raw meeting notes; it replies with the summary, decisions and action items.
description:
Forward the notes from any meeting, however messy, and it replies with a short summary for people who missed it, the decisions that were made, and every action item with its owner and due date.

It only uses what the notes say. An action item with no owner or date is marked that way, not filled in with a guess.

It works entirely from email. Nothing is read from or written to your files.

capabilities.name: Summary
capabilities.description: Two or three sentences for people who missed the meeting.

capabilities.name: Decisions
capabilities.description: Lists what was decided, one line each.

capabilities.name: Action items
capabilities.description: Every task with its owner and due date, marked when either is missing.
